No submitted reviews; Codex review comment reports usage limit, not an approval

Watcher and dispatcher now retain protection until confirmed aggregate flat balance; multi-account empty configuration fails closed. Remaining accepted-order/durable dedupe reconciliation still requires deeper review.

Malformed local strategy sell fraction previously raised non-SignalSizingError before broker submission, risking incorrect unknown-order ledger classification; now converted/validated with explicit pre-submission rejection
Non-numeric broker quote previously could abort stop-loss watcher cycle, skipping later tracked positions; now skip invalid quote per position and continue

Seven-day expiry and 10,000-entry truncation previously deleted executed/unknown/in_progress duplicate-protection identities, allowing old replay to re-submit broker orders. Now retain all non-retryable identities, prune only old provably retryable statuses, and fail closed when new claim exceeds cap.

KIS after-exchange numeric fields accepted float('inf') as positive buying power, allowing a full-size balance_split or score_max_capital BUY to pass an infinite budget into the broker path. Reject all nonfinite buying-power values before order sizing; regression cases cover inf/nan.

Unreadable/malformed reservation ledger was silently treated as empty, and persistence failures were only logged; accepted buys could reuse stale broker cash. Changed to fail closed, with tests for corruption, malformed shape, and write failure.

Nonfinite account cash and malformed reservation timestamp/amount could bypass reservation controls or pass invalid budgets to broker. Added finite nonnegative cash validation and fail-closed malformed reservation rejection.

Malformed nonfinite amount could be silently pruned by TTL before validation; even foreign-market corrupted reservations evaded validation. Validate finite positive amount and before_cash for all records before expiration or account filtering. One prior-head CI failure (754 passed, 1 failed) is addressed by this code change and expanded regression, but new-head CI not yet verified.

risk_register.description: Previously 30-minute TTL could silently free unreflected accepted BUY budget; adjusted_cash falsely reconciled later reservations without any broker cash change; unknown broker outcome did not reserve budget; US auto-exchange fallback skipped reservation deduction. Retain unsettled reservations until observed cash reconciliation, use actual broker cash for each record, reserve unknown outcomes, and deduct US auto-exchange reservations. Remaining broker fill/order-id reconciliation needs safe demo validation.
